job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Business Platform (Ruby/Rails)
job.description: The Huntress team is looking for an innovative and highly motivated Senior Software Engineer to join our Business Platform team. You will focus on creating the technical vision for new and exciting features from the product roadmap.
responsibilities: Manage the technical aspects of the development of features for the Portal, including UX/UI and API-focused work
Develop high-quality software, software designs, and architecture, setting the standard for team excellence
Collaborate with Growth teams to build and optimize data-driven features, experiments, and user flows
Convert acceptance criteria into functional workflows, data models, and associated software design
Focus on the entire life cycle of the system, including evolution, configuration, and risk management
Ensure code quality and test code coverage through code reviews and test plan reviews
Lead the team in providing accurate estimates and taking ownership of the timely completion of work
Mentor and coach engineers, fostering an environment that values professional development
Motivate teams and promote collaboration and engagement
Build and evolve AI tooling and usage in daily development workflows
